name: Malpua
description: Fluffy semolina pancakes fried in ghee and soaked in sugar syrup, garnished with chopped nuts and cream.
ingredients: a handful of crushed green cardamom pods
a handful of fresh curry leaves, chopped
a generous spoonful of roasted cashews
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with ghee.
In a large bowl, whisk together the naan bread and red chili powder until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the lemon wedges with the water until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 20 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
